name: We Got Another Year
source:
Follow Roberto, as he starts his third semester of law school, having to navigate friendships, work, college, and a brand new problem that showed up in his life all of a sudden.

[From [url=https://douglaskim.itch.io/we-got-another-year]Itch.io[/url]]

This game has been cancelled, the story will be continued in the [url=https://douglaskim.itch.io/we-got-another-year-chapter-1]comic format[/url].
translation:
跟随罗伯托开始法学院的第三个学期，他必须应对友谊、工作、大学，以及突然出现在他生活中的一个全新问题。

[来自[url=https://douglaskim.itch.io/we-got-another-year]Itch.io[/url]]

该游戏已取消，故事将以[url=https://douglaskim.itch.io/we-got-another-year-chapter-1]漫画格式[/url]继续。
